description: An address's daily holder-pool entitlement (the pool pays UBI holders; other coins' fees fund it): USDC, plus a pot for each v3 pair token (gold, XAUm, first) from the Oct 18, 2026 round, paid in the pair or, for holders who choose it with prepare_pair_rewards_in_usdc, in USDC. What it already received on-chain, and UNSIGNED claim transactions for any remainder. Daily payouts are normally sent to wallets automatically, so the remainder is usually 0. Amounts are human units; fields ending in Raw or Wei are the token's smallest units.
name: get_holder_rewards
